headline: Bombay Super Hybrid Seeds Limited acquires land for expansion
sum: BSHSL has acquired new immovable property (land) to support future expansion, disclosed to NSE under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Rules.
detail: Bombay Super Hybrid Seeds Limited has informed the National Stock Exchange of India (NSE) of the purchase and acquisition of new land/immovable property as part of its future expansion plan. The disclosure was made via a Regulation 30 intimation on 19 June 2026. The notification indicates organic capacity expansion but does not detail the location, acreage, consideration amount, or timeline for commencement of development.
